root_cause.text: The function ftgmac100_alloc_rings() in the FTGMAC100 Ethernet driver returns -ENOMEM without freeing previously allocated memory (rx_skbs, tx_skbs, rxdes, txdes) when a subsequent allocation fails, causing memory leaks.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explicitly states "On intermediate failures it returned -ENOMEM directly, leaking resources allocated earlier in the function." The patch diff confirms that the original code had unconditional `return -ENOMEM` after each allocation failure, and the fix replaces them with structured goto labels to free all prior allocations before the final return.

agent_logs.evidence_points: The CVE description explicitly states "On intermediate failures it returned -ENOMEM directly, leaking resources allocated earlier in the function." The patch diff confirms that the original code had unconditional `return -ENOMEM` after each allocation failure, and the fix replaces them with structured goto labels to free all prior allocations before the final return.

candidates.rationale: This allocation succeeds but is never freed when any subsequent allocation fails, causing a memory leak.
Returns without freeing previously allocated memory when tx_skbs allocation fails (no prior allocations, but part of the pattern that causes leaks when later allocations fail).
Allocation that, if it fails, leaks the previously allocated tx_skbs memory.
Returns without freeing tx_skbs when rxdes allocation fails.
Allocation that, if it fails, leaks both tx_skbs and rxdes.
Returns without freeing tx_skbs and rxdes when txdes allocation fails.
Allocation that, if it fails, leaks tx_skbs, rxdes, and txdes.
Returns without freeing tx_skbs, rxdes, and txdes when rx_scratch allocation fails.

vuln_statements.explanation: Allocation of tx_skbs memory; if a subsequent allocation fails, this memory is not freed, causing a memory leak.
Returns -ENOMEM when tx_skbs allocation fails; at this point no prior allocations exist, but this return statement sets the pattern for subsequent failures that do leak memory.
Allocation of rxdes memory; if a subsequent allocation fails, tx_skbs and rxdes are not freed, causing a memory leak.
Returns -ENOMEM when rxdes allocation fails; tx_skbs memory is not freed before this return, causing a leak.
Allocation of txdes memory; if a subsequent allocation fails, tx_skbs, rxdes, and txdes are not freed, causing a memory leak.
Returns -ENOMEM when txdes allocation fails; tx_skbs and rxdes memory are not freed before this return, causing a leak.
Allocation of rx_scratch memory; if this allocation fails, all previously allocated memory (tx_skbs, rxdes, txdes) is leaked.
Returns -ENOMEM when rx_scratch allocation fails; tx_skbs, rxdes, and txdes memory are not freed before this return, causing a leak.
